visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Removing by Index Skips Elements
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Removing the even numbers from 1 2 4 6 7 should leave [1, 7], but the program leaves [1, 4, 7].

solution.explanation: When an element is removed, the next one slides into its index, but the loop then moves on to the next index and never looks at it. An Iterator keeps track of the position itself, so iterator.remove() is safe.
